_doc: THIRD HELD-OUT real project: CANopenNode (samples/realworld/CANopenNode, ~27K lines; an industrial CANopen stack; uncompiled — the microcontroller driver is only the blank template in example/). Questions written from facts verified in the source AFTER all Phase 2 fixes and BEFORE Verity was ever run on it. First run kept in bench/results/realworld_heldout3/first-run.* — never tune the first-run record; once fixed against, the suite is tuned-on.

cases.q: What happens when a monitored node's heartbeat times out?
What happens when a SYNC message has the wrong length?
What happens when the CAN controller goes bus-off?
Where is the NMT operating state set?
When is the heartbeat message sent?
What happens to the NMT state when an error occurs while the node is operational?
What happens when an SDO client requests an object that does not exist?
What does CO_fifo_write do when the fifo is full?
Where does the data in CANrxData come from?
